entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • dotnet test is broken in net10 rc2 in Microsoft.Testing.Platform (MTP) #51283
  • `dotnet run app.cs` does not work when ran from Linux filesystem root #51282
  • Why are there separate arguments for --project and --solution? #51273
  • [xUnit v3] Catastrophic failure: Test process did not return valid JSON (non-object) when using .NET 10 RC2 #51270
  • Please automatically include .net sdk version bumps in the VS release notes #51268
  • About .NET10 official release, which VS version will be required? #51266
  • [Regression] .NET 10 RC2 prunes `System.ValueTuple` package when multi-targeting `net462` and `net10.0` #51265
  • dotnet completions script pwsh generates an invalid script #51260
  • Can't Restore Workloads with Version #51259
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]With .NET10 GA installed, the size of total published folder for Blazor Wasm with AOT enable is the same with AOT disable. #51258
  • Can’t Clean Workloads After Deleting global.json #51254

Closed

  • References with access modifiers #26609
  • .NET 10 RC1: dotnet test calls fail when parameters end with .exe or .dll #51235
  • Cant use ValueTuple when targeting both `net462` and `net10.0` when using net10 rc2 sdk #51267
  • [WebToolsE2E]Create web project failed with error “Unable to find package Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore with verision 10.0.0 ” after installing SDK 10.0 RTM #51233
  • [NETSDKE2E]The "RTM" suffix still displays on NET10 GA installer UI #51253
